answer: One defense is a wandering audit: independent auditors wander unpredictably between the economy's entry inlets, and every identity must answer a live challenge at a randomly chosen inlet within minutes or lose its standing. An honest agent's voyage through the economy is punctuated by these surprise checks, each cheap for one real agent. A sybil farmer cannot predict which inlet the auditor will visit next, so every clone must be staffed and ready at all times - thousands of fakes mean thousands of live attendants, and staffing them costs more than any reward they earn.
